items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: That name sounds familiar, but I just can't place it.

ctx.x: They called him some? Jimmy Noon. He played more when he got to Chicago on clarinet. Do you remember him playing clarinet here?
Jimmy Noon. That name sounds familiar, but I just can't place it. Jimmy Noon.
He was a friend of Freddie Keppard's and all.
